intro: I led UX and content for the Eight & Sand digital rebrand, building a low-maintenance, clean, human-centered layout on an accessible, responsive CMS. The law firm's site features testimonials and referral highlights throughout. The pages include a homepage, attorney bio pages with accomplishments and common questions, a testimonials page from co-counsel and referring attorneys, case outcome statistics, and a firm history page. Each page opens on a wide landscape or road photograph under a large italic serif quote. Content then moves through blocks of warm gold, teal, and cream, with common questions stacked in colored bars, and closes on a gold footer band. On the testimonials page, large italic pull quotes sit beside each full review. The result is a professional, low-touch presence that reinforces the firm's reputation and referrals.
